question: Below what amount of 2025 wages is an employer not required to give a household employee a Form W-2?
answer: An employer isn’t required to provide a Form W-2 to a household employee if they paid the employee less than $2,800 in 2025 wages.

This should include any tip income you didn’t report to your employer and any allocated tips shown in box 8 on your Form(s) W-2 unless you can prove that your unreported tips are less than the amount in box 8. Allocated tips aren’t included as income in box 1.
